text:
Yes. Hansen/UMD (GFC-2025-v1.13) mapped about 81.3 ha of tree-cover loss inside the property in 2021, roughly 2.23% of its 3,643.5 ha. The finding is corroborated: later years in the series were observed, and the JRC 2020 forest map agrees on 98% of the event area.

Context: according to the MGAP 2021 map, about 68.1 ha of the affected area was planted forest (Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda), 13.2 ha was outside mapped forest, and none was native forest. A further 37.3 ha of loss in patches under 0.5 ha was not counted as an event.

Limits: Hansen loss includes any stand replacement, such as harvesting a plantation. This result does not establish deforestation, land-use change, cause, legality, who was responsible, or any compliance status.
